versions.text: The methods of fabrication used must produce consistently sound structures. If a fabrication process (such as gluing, spot welding, or heat-treating) requires close control to reach this objective, the process must be performed under an approved process specification.

[(a) The methods of fabrication used must produce consistently sound structures. If a fabrication process (such as gluing, spot welding, or heat-treating) requires close control to reach this objective, the process must be performed under an approved process specification. (b) Each new aircraft fabrication method must be substantiated by a test program.] Notice of Airworthiness Review Program No. 2; Notice No. 75-10; Issued on 02/27/75.
